name: rao_v60
description: Single-pour V60 with bloom stage and 5:00 target

stages.name: Place cup
stages.instruction: Place your empty dosing cup on the scale, then tap Tare scale

stages.name: Dose beans
stages.instruction: Add beans to the cup, tap Log dose when done

stages.name: Prep
stages.instruction: Grind beans, rinse filter, place cup + V60 on scale. Tap Ready to arm

stages.name: Bloom
stages.instruction: Pour to [brew:stage_weight_target]g, then swirl gently. [brew:stage_time_remaining]s remaining

stages.name: Main pour
stages.instruction: Pour steadily in circles to [brew:stage_weight_target]g, tap Done when finished
